title: SigFM
summary: A benchmarking framework built on SDGym that runs and compares multiple tabular data synthesizers (CTGAN, TVAE, CopulaGAN, UniformSynthesizer, RealTabFormer, GaussianCopula, STaSy, TabDiff) over standard tabular datasets, evaluating outputs with SDMetrics quality metrics like RangeCoverage and KSComplement. It directly imports and runs sdgym.benchmark, sdv.datasets.demo, rdt transformers, and sdmetrics reports to execute and score the synthesizers, making SDGym/SDV/RDT/SDMetrics the core evaluation harness of the project.
